title: Key Strategies for Local Instagram Success
takeaway: Focus on location tagging and showing the process to build local trust.

data.label: Consistency
data.value: Post two or three times a week. That is enough.
data.evidence: Do not try to post every single day. That leads to burnout. Instead. Post two or three times a week. That is enough. Doing it consistently is the key.

data.label: Visibility
data.value: Tag your city or service area in every single post.
data.evidence: You must tell Instagram exactly where you operate. Tag your city or service area in every single post. If you are a mechanic in Denver tag Denver. If you are a bakery in Seattle tag Seattle.

data.label: Trust Building Proof
data.value: Show the process. Film a short video of you are working on a job site.
data.evidence: Show the process. Film a short video of you are working on a job site.

data.label: Call to Action
data.value: Ask them to call a specific number for a quote.
data.evidence: Ask them to call a specific number for a quote.
